profile.headline: Flight Software @ Electra | Harvard CS | Ex-Microsoft | Space Cadet
profile.summary:
Hoping to put a human on Mars and/or all humans out of the driver's seat. Curious to see which will happen first.

My regular powers include a childlike curiosity and an unwavering desire to make the world more awesome. Currently, I would love to hear more about any and all opportunities in space exploration, flight, mobility, and/or education. My other running interests are in sports, economics, robotics, natural language understanding, photography, guitar, artificial intelligence, machine learning, among others.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: • Developing flight software for the Electra EL2, the world’s first hybrid-electric ultra short take off and landing (eSTOL) aircraft
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software · Software Architecture · Flight Control · C (Programming Language) · JavaScript

positions.title: Aircraft Systems and Avionics Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Modeling real-time systems at TRU Simulation, a subsidiary of Textron Aviation
    - Beechcraft Denali single-engine turboprop full flight simulator (FFS)
    - Cessna Citation Ascend midsize jet FFS
    - Cessna Citation CJ4 Gen3 light jet FFS
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Real-time Simulation · Systems Modeling · Software Architectural Design · Linux

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Azure Compute
    - Cluster extensions for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
    - Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes (K8s)
    - Azure Automanage

positions.title: Teaching Fellow for CS 161: Operating Systems
positions.description:
• Received Harvard University's Certificate of Distinction in Teaching
• Taught & led discussions in recitation sections
• Held office hours guiding students through building their own OS kernel

positions.title: Data Science & Machine Learning Project Lead
positions.description:
• Architected & developed statistical and machine learning models to forecast flight delays & air traffic meltdowns to aid airlines and air traffic management 
• Funded by the NASA Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) grant

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

positions.title: Research Software Engineer Intern in Natural Language Understanding (NLU)
positions.description:
• Investigated & boosted the performance of the Alexa Fire TV NLU model stack on new video titles
• Developed an unsupervised semantic clustering toolkit & an exploratory data analysis library

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Developed an iOS bus tracking app & a real-time iOS face recognition app for JPL’s internal use
• Designed and mocked up UI/UX of other JPL internal websites and mobile apps in Figma

positions.title: Course Assistant
positions.description:
• Held office hours breaking down concepts like merge sort & tries to first-time CS students
• Guided students towards better algorithmic thinking & helped debug their code

positions.title: Mechanical Designer on Mars Rover Project
positions.description:
• Computer designed, prototyped, & integrated rover components (rails, mounts, shells, ...)
• Modeled existing parts & incorporated them into the rover’s Solidworks assembly

positions.title: Bench Technician
positions.description:
• Troubleshot and repaired computer hardware and software
(Windows, Mac, and Linux)

positions.title: Programming and Electrical Captain
positions.description:
• Programmed, wired, & implemented the robot’s actuators & sensors
• Managed meetings, scheduling, task distribution, budget, fundraising, & other logistics

company.name: Holliston High School FIRST Robotics Team 2262

positions.title: Laboratory Technician
positions.description: • Performed liquid chromatography and mass spectroscopy to purify synthesized DNA/RNA

projects.title: Chess Kit
projects.description: Building from scratch a drag-and-drop chess game with a negamax AI agent searching for best moves in an underlying bitboard representation
